About the job

Description

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth.

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

The Marketing intern will be involved in the learning experience of various marketing initiatives and learn firsthand how to set up, run, track and optimize traffic campaigns. Projects can cover the full range of modern marketing vehicles – from social, content, email, mobile to large-scale event marketing. The successful candidate will be trained in building and engaging our customer base via demand and lead generation campaigns, and in learning how to creating effective strategies that will promote the long-term growth of the business.

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Organic growth is being rebuilt. Traditional SEO is being disrupted by AI driven answer engines that synthesize information directly rather than listing links. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) is the emerging frontier, optimizing for LLM visibility, ensuring your brand and products appear in AI generated answers, and building content systems that earn organic presence in a world where the algorithm is an intelligence, not just a crawler.

As Growth Workflow Specialist (Organic Growth), you will automate and scale the organic growth engine. Working closely with our organic growth strategy lead, you translate SEO and AEO strategy into automated workflows, content brief generation pipelines, LLM visibility monitoring, content deployment automation, competitor gap analysis, and more. You are the person who takes what the strategist knows and makes it run at the speed and scale that only automation enables.

While your primary focus is organic search and content distribution, you will also contribute to automating other growth levers, including CRO content, onboarding copy, geo localized content workflows, and other growth surfaces, as the engine expands. The systems thinking transfers across every growth function.

The opportunity


Build and maintain the organic growth automation pipeline, from keyword and visibility signal ingestion to content brief generation to CMS deployment
Work with the organic growth strategy lead to translate SEO/AEO strategy into workflow specs the build team can implement
Monitor LLM visibility across priority topics, products, and markets, and automate the alerting and response workflows when visibility shifts
Automate content brief generation, pulling competitive gaps, search signal, and AEO data into structured briefs that feed the AI creative layer
QA content outputs from the AI content agents, ensuring accuracy, brand alignment, and SEO/AEO best practice compliance before deployment
Define knowledge base inputs for the organic growth agents, what content rules, standards, and market specific requirements should be codified
Extend your systems thinking to other growth levers as the engine scales, CRO content, onboarding copy, localization workflows, and beyond


What You Bring


3+ years in SEO with strong technical understanding, you understand how crawling, indexing, and ranking work, and you think about content as a system
Familiarity with AEO and LLM visibility concepts, you understand how AI answer engines work and what it takes to appear in them
CMS and content pipeline experience, comfortable working with content management systems and automated content deployment workflows
Systems thinking, you can map an organic content workflow as a series of triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements
Data comfort, you can interpret organic performance data, identify what's working, and define what an agent should optimize for
Strong written communication, your workflow specs become the build team's blueprints. Precision matters. 


Nice to haves


Experience with programmatic SEO or content automation at scale
Familiarity with SEO monitoring, LLM visibility tracking, or competitive intelligence platforms
Background in regulated industries where content compliance adds complexity
Any hands-on experience with workflow automation or no-code orchestration tools
Experience with AI content generation tools or LLM APIs


Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

About the job

Elogia es un partner estratégico que transforma las operaciones digitales de las marcas en crecimiento. Lo hace desde el enfoque Full Digital Commerce, que integra marketing, producto y logística.




Pertenece a VIKO, un ecosistema de negocios especializados en impulsar el crecimiento de las marcas desde 1999. Actualmente, está formado por: Elogia, Socialmood, Kraz, Candee, Optopus, Marketing4eCommerce y Elev8.




Oriol Chías, que forma parte del equipo desde el principio, cuenta que VIKO nació porque un grupo de personas que se entendían y disfrutaban trabajando juntas quiso seguir colaborando. Ahí se sembró una cultura People First que nos acompaña hasta hoy.




Ahora, contamos con más de 25 años de trayectoria, oficinas en España y México, y un equipo de más de 300 personas que hacen posible todo esto. 23 de ellas llevan más de 10 años trabajando juntas y 25 decidieron volver al equipo tras un tiempo fuera.

Las personas y el buen ambiente de trabajo.

Impulsar el crecimiento de nuestros clientes a través de campañas de Paid Media eficientes, bien ejecutadas y orientadas a resultados, optimizando cada peso invertido para maximizar el rendimiento.

About the job

This offer is exclusively for bilingual candidates (Spanish & English)

Please make sure to answer all questions on the application form; incomplete forms will be discarded




We’re Hiring!

We’re Angel Host, a Canadian-based, data-driven, and tech-enabled vacation rental performance company that helps property managers and owners worldwide outperform their markets. By taking care of pricing, reservations, channel marketing, and guest services, we enable our clients to focus on growing their business while maximizing the performance of their property portfolio and reducing their day-to-day workload.

Today, we manage 600+ properties across the United States, Mexico, the Caribbean, Canada, and Europe.

Does our mission resonate with you? Are you looking to work in a fast-paced, fun, and flexible environment with unlimited opportunities for growth and learning? Does being part of a rapidly growing startup, surrounded by talented people from around the world, sound exciting? If so, keep reading!




The position: Guest Services Agent – LATAM (English/Spanish), Pacific Time Evening Shift, 25 hrs/week




This role is ideal for candidates based in Mexico (preferably Baja California or Tijuana or anywhere on the West Coast)

As a Guest Services Agent, you’ll be responsible for delivering exceptional online service to guests from their very first inquiry until they leave a review.

This role covers our evening shift, including the daily handover between our Mexico and Europe teams. Because of this, you’ll need to make confident decisions, solve problems independently, and remain calm under pressure.

You’ll be joining an international Guest Services team spread across multiple countries and time zones, working together to support more than 500 properties around the clock.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. We believe every guest deserves a welcoming, caring, and personalized experience, while every property owner deserves a partner they can trust to protect their business and reputation.




Specifically, we need you to:




Respond promptly in writing or by phone call to guest inquiries in English and Spanish, researching the best solutions whenever needed.
Handle a high volume of guest communications through our Property Management System (PMS) and automation softwares.
Resolve guest issues before, during, and after their stay by coordinating with property owners and local property managers.
Provide timely responses to inquiries to maximize reservation conversions.
Process payments for additional services, damage claims, and refunds when applicable.
Think creatively and proactively to ensure outstanding guest experiences while protecting our clients’ interests.
Respond professionally to post-stay guest reviews and dispute them if needed.




Is this job for you? Well, it is if you:




Have experience in Guest Services, Hospitality, Travel, Tourism, Customer Support, or another client-facing role involving chat, email, or written communication.
Hold a degree or formal training in Hospitality (a strong advantage, even if your professional experience is limited).
Have excellent written English and Spanish skills. A written assessment in both languages will be part of the hiring process. Applicants should be confident they can achieve a score of 85/100 or higher.
You are comfortable working a 25-hour/week schedule consisting of 5-hour shifts, based on Pacific Time, typically between 5:00 PM and 12:00 AM PT. Weekend availability is required.
Have a reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a backup plan in case of connectivity issues. This is a fully remote role, so a dependable workspace is essential.
Have excellent judgment and remain calm under pressure. This shift often requires resolving guest issues independently during the daily handover between our Mexico and Europe teams.
Bring a positive attitude and enjoy contributing to a collaborative, supportive team environment.
Take initiative and naturally look for ways to improve processes rather than waiting to be told what to do. The phrase “that’s not my responsibility” doesn’t exist in your vocabulary.
Have strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively.
Enjoy learning and using new technologies.
Can comfortably multitask while maintaining attention to detail.
Experience with Guesty and HubSpot is a plus.
Love working with people and being part of an amazing team.




What’s in it for you?

We believe that attracting exceptional people means offering an exceptional work environment. While we’re passionate about our work, we also value balance, flexibility, and making time for the things that matter most.

As our Guest Services Agent, you’ll receive:

Competitive salary for a 25-hour/week schedule, with annual salary reviews and opportunities for career growth.
Paid vacation plus all national holidays.
25-hour/week schedule consisting of 5-hour shifts, based on Pacific Time, typically between 5:00 PM and 12:00 AM PT. Weekend availability is required.
The freedom to work remotely from anywhere with a reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace.
Monthly allowances for internet and computer usage.
Up to 3 paid volunteer days per year through our Angels Care program, allowing you to support the charity of your choice.
A genuine opportunity to grow into a full-time Guest Services position as you build experience and tenure with the team.

 

Additional Information

This position is a 25-hour/week independent contractor role, expected to start shortly after the hiring process is completed. You’ll participate in an onboarding, training, and shadowing period before independently taking ownership of your shift.

At Angel Host, we’re not just providing a service, we’re helping redefine the future of short-term rental performance.

If you’re ready to bring your skills, energy, and ideas to a company that values growth, collaboration, innovation, and client success, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Incident Interface: Serve as the technical point of contact for major migration incidents, coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer’s revenue during "cutover" phases.
Proactively monitor technical trends and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure the migrated environment is optimized for performance and stability.


Required Qualifications


Experience: 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a specific focus on large-scale migrations.
Domain Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
Consulting Skills: Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and handle objections at the stakeholder level.
Technical Fluency: Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business terms and guide customers through complex data transformations.
Collaboration: Proven track record of working successfully with global/offshore delivery models (GDC) to accelerate project timelines.

Platform Mastery: Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service) or specialized clouds (Marketing/Data/Revenue/Tableau).
AI Engagement: Familiarity with using AI agents or automation tools to handle data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
Integration Knowledge: Understanding of how the target cloud integrates with telephony, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.

Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, or Tableau Desktop Specialist).
Prior experience as an Individual Contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation projects.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist- B2B Services- English Required -Mérida Hibrido
skills: Planear, ejecutar y optimizar campañas de paid media en Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads y TikTok Ads para mercados de México y Estados Unidos
Gestionar presupuestos y tomar decisiones de inversión basadas en métricas de negocio: CPL, ROAS, CAC y LTV
Implementar y mantener el stack de tracking: GA4, GTM, UTMs y HubSpot CRM
Cerrar el ciclo completo: pauta → lead → pipeline → cierre, en coordinación con el equipo comercial
Generar reportes ejecutivos y presentar resultados en inglés y español
Crear y optimizar campañas con copy, conceptos y audiencias en inglés para audiencias americanas

Inglés avanzado de trabajo — No es suficiente con leer documentación o revisar con IA. Necesitamos a alguien que opere en inglés: entienda conceptos de IA y tech en inglés, redacte copy de campañas en inglés con naturalidad y pueda comunicarse con equipos o clientes en inglés sin fricción.
Experiencia en campañas para mercado americano — Haber lanzado y optimizado campañas activas dirigidas a audiencias en Estados Unidos. No exploratorias: campañas con resultados comprobados.

Experiencia en B2B de servicios profesionales — Haber generado leads para venta de servicios (consultoría, tecnología, staffing, agencias, servicios financieros, legales, educativos u otros servicios B2B). El ciclo de venta de un servicio es diferente al de un producto o una propiedad — necesitamos a alguien que ya lo haya navigado.
Dominio de Meta Ads y Google Ads con ejecución directa y métricas de performance documentadas.
Radicar en Mérida, Yucatán — posición híbrida, asistencia a oficinas en City 32.
LinkedIn Ads y TikTok Ads
HubSpot CRM
Experiencia en sector tech, SaaS o IT services
Uso de herramientas de IA para optimización de campañas
Certificaciones en Google Ads o Meta Blueprint
Operar y optimizar la inversión en paid media en todos los canales (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn y TikTok).
Definir la estrategia por canal según su rol en el funnel: búsqueda para demanda activa, redes sociales para conversión y retargeting, y validación continua de nuevos canales.
Escalar el presupuesto de forma gradual y basada en evidencia, invirtiendo más solo en lo que demuestra funcionar.
Garantizar tracking y atribución de principio a fin (UTMs, conversiones e integridad de datos en el CRM) para que la inversión sea trazable a pipeline.
Entregar un reporte semanal de desempeño de la pauta: costo por lead, retorno de la inversión, leads calificados y pipeline por canal.
Mantener un histórico ordenado y confiable del desempeño de las campañas.
Colaborar con los equipos de contenido y diseño para las creatividades, y con el equipo de eventos para la pauta de registro.
Planeación: segmentación por caso de uso, industria, producto y mercado (México y Estados Unidos se trabajan distinto), y definición de objetivo, presupuesto, canales y métricas.
Construcción y lanzamiento: configuración de campañas, audiencias, pujas y creatividades, con una verificación de la medición de principio a fin antes de encender.
Optimización en vivo: monitoreo, pruebas A/B y reasignación de presupuesto entre canales según la eficiencia.
Cierre: análisis de resultados contra la meta, aprendizajes y recomendación (escalar, mantener, iterar o descartar).
Reducción sostenida del costo por lead hacia niveles de referencia de la industria B2B tech.
Volumen de leads calificados generados por pauta, con crecimiento sostenido.
Pipeline y revenue atribuibles a la pauta, y retorno de la inversión por campaña.
Porcentaje de la inversión que es trazable a pipeline, con la meta de que sea total.
Eficiencia por canal y reasignación de presupuesto basada en datos.

About the job
This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

DaCodes es una AI software company con sede en Mérida, Yucatán. Construimos AI Agents, plataformas AI-Native y software empresarial para clientes de México y Estados Unidos, incluyendo marcas como Rappi, Soriana, Costco, Walmart y Royal Resorts. No buscamos a alguien que ejecute campañas y espere resultados: buscamos a alguien que entienda el negocio, defienda sus decisiones con datos y sepa conectar cada peso invertido con oportunidades reales de venta. Esta posición tiene alto impacto directo desde el día uno.

About the job

KittySpout is looking for experienced Customer Support Agents to join our team on an hourly contract basis — starting within the next 1–4 days!




We're working through a high volume of tickets and need proven, fast, experienced agents who can jump in immediately with minimal ramp-up. You'll manage customer interactions across Email, and turn frustrated customers into brand advocates with fast, empathetic, effective solutions.




To be clear upfront: this is hourly contract work, 30–40+ hours per week for the next several weeks. If you perform at a high level, there is a real opportunity to convert into a permanent full-time position on the team.




We're looking for someone with 3+ years of high-volume e-commerce support experience, excellent English, and hands-on experience with subscription-related tickets (cancellations, saves, refunds, failed payments). The ideal candidate has worked at DTC brands, understands first-contact resolution, and can handle heavy volume without sacrificing quality or brand voice. Speed is the single most important trait for this role.


Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.


What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring — even for contract roles.

We are a fast-moving, data-driven team with no corporate politics. Everyone is hands-on, and if something needs doing, you do it — regardless of whether it's "in your job description." We value speed, ownership, and people who overdeliver without being asked. This is not a 9–5 corporate role, and this role in particular exists because we're in a high-volume period: we need someone who sees a full queue as a challenge to beat, not a reason to stress.




The right person for this role is fast, self-directed, and reliable. You'll get clear policies, macros, training and a well-organized helpdesk — and then we'll trust you to run your queue without hand-holding. You won't be micromanaged, and you won't be waiting around for approvals. Support is the voice of our brand, and we treat great agents accordingly: your CSAT and resolution numbers get seen, and strong performance here is the direct path to a permanent full-time seat on the team.

Our core values: Work Smart. Overdeliver. Speed is King. Better Every Day.




Key Objectives

Resolve a high volume of tickets (100+ tickets per day) while maintaining a friendly, helpful tone.
Handle subscription tickets — cancellations, saves, refunds, failed payments — confidently and according to policy.
Apply problem-solving principles to resolve shipping, product, and technical issues autonomously.
Operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing your queue efficiently to meet SLA deadlines without hand-holding.
Hit the ground running in Richpanel and Shopify from day one — this is not a "learn on the job" situation given the timeline.
Ensure every interaction meets our quality standards, minimizing follow-ups and escalations.
Maintain clear, proactive communication with the operations team to report recurring product issues or shipping delays.


Requirements

Fully remote.
Available to start within 1–4 days and commit 30–40+ hours per week for the next several weeks.
Fluent English, written and spoken — professional or native level. This is non-negotiable.
3+ years of Customer Support experience for DTC e-commerce brands.
Proven hands-on experience with Richpanel (this is our helpdesk) and Shopify. Gorgias/Zendesk experience is a plus, but Richpanel proficiency means you start faster.
Direct experience handling subscription-related tickets (billing, cancellations, saves, chargebacks).
Speed & Accuracy: fast typing, comfortable navigating multiple tabs/tools simultaneously.
No issue working overtime or weekends when needed — we're in a high-volume period and that's exactly why this role exists.
Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.




KPIs You Will Own

Daily Ticket Quota: consistent resolution of 100+ assigned tickets per day.
Average Response Time: under 1 hour during shift.
CSAT Score: maintain 4.8/5.0 or higher.


This Role Is Not For You If

You are a perfectionist who spends 20 minutes drafting a single email. With 100+ tickets a day, success demands efficiency — macros/templates combined with quick personalization.
You thrive on frequent meetings and constant collaboration. This is a high-autonomy, heads-down role where you work the queue independently for most of your shift.
You struggle with fast-paced changes. Policies and promotions can change overnight, and you must pivot and learn new protocols instantly without frustration.
You can't start this week. We are onboarding immediately — if your earliest start is 2+ weeks out, this isn't the right posting for you.


How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

We are moving extremely fast on this role. The process: submit the application, and if you're a strong fit we'll reach out within 24 hours for a single interview covering technical skills (mock tickets) and culture fit. We aim to have you onboarded and working tickets within 1–4 days of applying. We pride ourselves on timely responses — we won't leave you hanging.

Once you start, we'll define your KPIs and targets together, so there's zero ambiguity about whether you're doing a good job.


Compensation

USD $7–$9 per hour, based on experience and expertise. 30–40+ hours per week to start. Top performers have the opportunity to convert to a permanent full-time role.

About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The Team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro team is responsible for everything to do with the trading backend services such as the matching engine, market data gateways, internal and external APIs, and various other trading services. The team is located globally and responsibilities are split into sub-teams, working with various tech stacks. Our teams code in Rust and work agile around the globe. Recently, the team played a critical role in scaling Kraken's trading infrastructure.

As an SDET II within Kraken Pro, you'll operate as an experienced individual contributor focused on quality engineering, automation, and developer productivity.

You'll own significant areas of Kraken's testing infrastructure, automation frameworks, and CI/CD tooling while partnering closely with engineers to improve reliability, testability, and release confidence across the Pro organisation.

Depending on the team or product area you join, you may work on matching engine services, market data infrastructure, external APIs, Futures and Derivatives systems, and other areas of the Pro trading stack.

Strong Python/Rust/C++ skills with experience building production-quality automation frameworks, tooling, or internal engineering systems.
Deep backend and API testing experience across REST, WebSocket, and protocols such as gRPC or FIX, including distributed systems.
Experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, testing infrastructure, and containerised environments.
Experience within trading systems or other real-time, high-availability environments, with strong understanding of reliability, latency, and system behaviour.

Demonstrated ability to investigate complex system failures and collaborate with engineers to drive resolution.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, or MCP integrations to improve engineering productivity.

Desarrollo y ejecución de los JBPs con los principales retailers digitales y omnicanales, incrementando nuestra presencia en las plataformas prioritarias y ganando en el anaquel digital a través de estrategias de Retail Media, search, merchandising solutions y optimización de la conversión.

10% Enlace con los equipos digitales de Hershey Internacional para identificar oportunidades y BDPs que aceleren el crecimiento sostenible del negocio en México y a nivel Internacional.

About the job

Are you an experienced voice actor eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models and speech technologies are evolving rapidly, moving beyond simple interactions into expressive, human-like communication. Ready to channel your Japanese voice expertise into building the AI voices of tomorrow? Apply today and help shape the model that will speak to millions around the world.

We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer, high-quality microphone and recording setup, and stable internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

Your focus will be on defining long-term policies, evaluating the financial ROI of operational decisions, and leading high-level institutional negotiations to build a proactive, data-driven governance framework for our merchant partner ecosystem.

In this role, you'll be...


Leading Merchant Operations Strategy: Design, execute, and continually refine long-term strategic frameworks to optimize partner delivery operations, marketplace quality, and overall merchant success.
Optimizing Core Logistics Metrics: Partner directly with Product and Analytics teams to resolve merchant-level bottlenecks, focusing on preparation times, avoidable courier waiting times, cancellation rates, and restaurant delays.

Implementing Positive Performance Policies: Develop and maintain platform compliance policies and incentive-driven performance frameworks, prioritizing positive enablement before deploying platform restrictions.

Streamlining Internal Communication: Centralize commercial requests through a formal intake channel and coordinating upcoming campaigns with sales teams to ensure adequate delivery capacity.
Developing Shared-Value Initiatives: Coordinate joint projects with partner brands to implement tactical, store-level initiatives that drive operational value and enhance the courier ecosystem experience.
Centralizing Performance Metrics: Establish standardized measurement mechanisms, including periodic partner sentiment and perception surveys.
Driving Strategic Alignment: Shape the long-term roadmap by regularly presenting data-driven business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and strategic policy updates to senior executives.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Experience: 5-7+ years of professional experience in operations, corporate strategy, consulting, or high-growth tech startups. Proven experience in Merchant Operations or high-level Institutional Account Management within the food delivery or mobility industry is highly preferred.
Stakeholder Alignment & Negotiation Acumen: High-level corporate negotiation and communication skills. Demonstrated ability to navigate complex cross-functional environments and align senior commercial directors and operational teams under strict policy frameworks without formal authority.
Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven problem-solving skills with a track record of translating complex metrics into financial ROI models and clear business guardrails.
Leadership and Drive: A proven ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently and effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous cross-functional environments.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Mathematics, or related fields. An MBA is highly valued but optional.
Technical Toolkit: Strong SQL proficiency and advanced Excel/Google Sheets capabilities are required. Direct experience with BI platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) is highly desirable.
Languages: Professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal).



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

The eCommerce Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day health of eCommerce operations by monitoring execution across order management, payments, fulfillment, and post-purchase activities. This role focuses on ensuring that operational processes run smoothly across systems, partners, and teams, while minimizing customer impact and operational risk. The Specialist acts as a key connector between Customer Service, IT, Logistics, and internal business stakeholders to maintain a reliable, customer-centric eCommerce operation.

Operational Oversight


Identify, troubleshoot, and escalate order-related issues that may impact fulfillment, payment processing, or customer experience.
Oversee operational processes related to orders, returns, refunds, and payment exceptions to ensure accuracy, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
Support investigations into payment disputes, delivery claims, and account discrepancies in collaboration with Logistics and Customer Service teams.
Ensure operational issues are identified, addressed, and escalated appropriately to maintain business continuity and customer trust.


Customer Experience Enablement


Act as a primary operational point of contact for Customer Service escalations regarding customer inquiries.
Ensure timely resolution of customer-impacting issues and drive clear communication when service disruptions or internal issues occur.
Support customer recovery efforts through appropriate resolution tools, messaging, and remediation strategies.


Cross-Functional Coordination


Partner with IT teams to address technical or integration issues affecting order management platforms and ERP systems.
Document and maintain operational processes, guidelines, and best practices to drive consistency and efficiency.
Identify recurring issues or trends and recommend process improvements to reduce friction and operational risk.


Reporting & Business Support


Track and report on key operational activities and issues to support visibility and informed decision-making.
Provide insights into case drivers, trends, and operational performance to help guide process optimization efforts.

Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Clear, professional communication and collaboration skills.
Detail-oriented with a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
Customer-focused perspective with sound judgment and adaptability in ambiguous situations.

3+ years of professional experience supporting operations or customer‑facing functions, ideally within an eCommerce, digital, or systems driven environment.
Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Familiarity with order management systems, ERP platforms, or third-party logistics environments.
Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

About Us - Malvern Panalytical, Micromeritics And SciAps.

Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.

We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.

Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.

Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. Our leading technologies measure surface area, porosity, density, adsorption and particle activity.

SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.

We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are more than 2,500 employees in a customer-focused organization with sales and service offices in 20 countries, all committed to delivering expert and responsive customer support.

We are part of Spectris. Spectris combines precision with purpose, delivering progress for a more sustainable world. About the job

Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you are a dedicated professional with extensive customer service and technical support experience. Your expertise is mostly in diagnosing issues, reporting bugs and incidents, providing practical solutions, and enhancing user satisfaction, including within international payroll, benefits, and EOR contexts. With a keen eye for detail and a commitment to excellence, you have a proven track record of successfully managing complex customer support cases, resolving critical moments, and developing innovative solutions that improve service delivery.

You have a unique ability to adapt your technical knowledge to assist our frontline support with a variety of situations, including navigating global customer scenarios, diagnosing their problems, and ensuring they receive timely and accurate solutions. You have the drive to continually identify and provide critical feedback to our internal teams to improve our product offerings and functions, including those supporting international expansion. You are excellent at communicating complex information about our product, processes, and international requirements in an understandable and patient way, which will be vital to building strong relationships with our internal customers and team members.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On


Serve as a primary point of contact for high-level customer support inquiries, including international payroll, benefits, and EOR-related cases, ensuring a positive resolution.
Own subject matter expertise across Justworks products, with a specialization in international offerings, and partner closely with Product teams.
Collaborate with Solutions, Incident Management, Technical, Product Development, and International teams to identify, analyze, and resolve complex domestic and global product issues.

How You Will Do Your Work

As a CX Specialist, how results are achieved directly impacts your success and ultimately our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

Consultative - takes an approach that focuses on building relationships with others, understanding their problems, and developing solutions to their challenges through open-ended questions and active listening.

Taking responsibility - being accountable, being committed, and accepting ownership for one's decisions, actions, and behavior.

Adaptability - the ability to adjust your approach or actions in response to changes in your external environment.

Solution-oriented - identifies the source of a question or challenge and provides the right or a better way of doing things.Curious - the innate desire to learn, grow, and understand.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:


Camaraderie - Day to day, you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example. 
Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

Exceptional problem-solving skills with a proven track record of resolving complex technical issues.

description:
About the job

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

Why this role is important to us

SimCorp leverages the most sophisticated risk analytics and portfolio-construction tools on the market, with a globally diverse client base that challenges us to continue innovating.

SimCorp is currently seeking a qualified professional to join our Global Support team as a full-time employee. The position will be based in our Mexico City office. Candidates should have a minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Economics, or 1-2 years of relevant work experience with a related undergraduate degree. Beyond the opportunity to work directly with clients, team members will gain invaluable industry experience while working in a challenging, yet fun work environment.

Responsibilities


Respond to optimization, risk analysis, attribution, and risk modeling questions from clients.
Provide structured and custom training for new and existing clients.
Assist clients in translating their portfolio construction strategies into Axioma products, while providing helpful insights into Axioma’s innovative methods. Assist Sales Team members in creating proof-of-concept analysis via portfolio analysis and product demonstrations.
Provide specialized guidance during evaluations of SimCorp's software products including initial training, day-to-day usage questions, and by supporting the Sales and Product Specialists teams during client trials.
Assist sales organization as necessary to facilitate effective client retention and new business development.
Collaborate with senior Global Support staff and other SimCorp resources in responding to advanced client inquiries.


Qualifications


Proficient written and oral communication skills.
Minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Economics, or 1-2 years relevant work experience with a related undergraduate degree.
Knowledge with or experience with multi asset class securities (equity, fixed income, FX, and derivatives).
Solid educational foundation in math and statistics, familiar with linear and non-linear methods of interpretation in market theory and quantitative disciplines of risk analytics / portfolio construction.
Proficient computer skills and experience with coding languages (R, Python preferred, Java).
Skilled at problem solving and quickly identifying problem resolution for clients.
Commitment to assisting and teaching clients how to benefit from SimCorp products.


Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on enhancing your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS 

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients, with SimCorp as the overarching company brand and Axioma as a key product brand.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

While seeking to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

description:
About the job

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

Why this role is important to us

SimCorp leverages the most sophisticated risk analytics and portfolio-construction tools on the market, with a globally diverse client base that challenges us to continue innovating.

SimCorp is currently seeking a qualified professional to join our Customer Support team as a full-time employee. The position will be based in our Mexico City office. Candidates should have a minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Economics, or 1-2 years of relevant experience with a related degree. Beyond the opportunity to work directly with clients, team members will gain invaluable industry experience while working in a challenging, yet fun work environment.

What You Will Be Responsible For


Research and respond to pricing, risk analysis, attribution, and risk modeling questions from clients. 
Provide structured and custom training for new and existing clients. 
Assist clients in translating their risk analytics strategies into SimCorp products, while providing helpful insights into SimCorp’s innovative methods. 
Assist Sales Team members in creating proof-of-concept analysis via portfolio analysis and product demonstrations. 
Provide expert guidance during evaluations of SimCorp's software products including initial training, day-to-day usage questions, and by supporting the Sales and Product Specialists teams during client trials. 
Assist sales organization as necessary to facilitate strong client retention and new business development. 
Collaborate with senior Client Services staff and other SimCorp resources in responding to advanced client inquiries. 


What We Value


Strong written and oral English communication skills. 
Minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Economics, or 1-2 years relevant experience with a related degree. 
Knowledge with or experience with multi asset class securities (equity, fixed income, FX, and derivatives). 
Understanding of risk management concepts such as greeks, VaR, and stress testing. 
Strong educational foundation in math and statistics, familiar with linear and non-linear methods of interpretation in market theory and quantitative disciplines of risk analytics / portfolio construction. 
Strong computer skills and experience with coding languages (R / Python preferred, Java a plus). 
Strong ability to problem solve and quickly identify problem resolution for clients. 
Passion for assisting and teaching clients how to maximize the benefit of SimCorp products. 


Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS 

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients, with SimCorp as the overarching company brand and Axioma as a key product brand.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

While seeking to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

title: Creator Operations Manager - TikTok LIVE
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
About TikTok LIVE
TikTok LIVE's mission is to work hand-in-hand with creators & influencers, agencies, and partner organizations to build an environment that connects communities in real time, enabling meaningful and interactive connections around the globe.

What You'll Do
Creators are at the heart of our ecosystem. As a Creator Operations Manager, you will be responsible for building, activating, and retaining a healthy creator community on TikTok LIVE. You will design and execute scalable operational strategies that empower creators to thrive, while ensuring sustainable growth and high-quality content supply.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute scalable creator programs to onboard, educate, and activate TikTok LIVE creators, driving sustainable platform growth.
- Design and implement incentive programs, campaigns, and reward systems to boost creator participation and improve retention rates.
- Craft tailored content and growth strategies targeting diverse creator segments to maximize performance across tiers.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Partnerships, Campaigns, Product, and Strategy—to align on creator growth initiatives.
- Partner with vendors and internal teams to create creator toolkits, educational materials, and training resources.
- Monitor and analyze creator funnel metrics (onboarding, activity, retention) to identify friction points and optimize operational workflows.
- Act as the primary source of creator insights, delivering data-driven recommendations to influence strategy and business decisions.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications: 
- 3 years of experience in creator operations, content operations, influencer management, digital marketing, or related fields in a platform or agency environment.
- Data-driven mindset with solid analytical skills; experience with performance tracking and funnel optimization.
- Strong operational and project management skills with the ability to execute programs at scale.
- Hands-on, proactive, and adaptable to fast-paced environments.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in English and Spanish; this role requires frequent communication LATAM teams, clients, and stakeholders to ensure smooth collaboration across key regions. 

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in the live streaming industry, creator economy, or community-centric platforms.
- Expertise in designing creator incentive programs and growth frameworks.
- Strong business acumen with the ability to translate insights into actionable growth strategies.
- Deep understanding of digital content trends, monetization models, and creator engagement best practices.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we’re a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We’re hiring an SEO / AEO Strategist to join a fast-growing digital agency serving mid-market and enterprise B2B software and SaaS clients — architecting and driving high-impact organic growth strategies at the intersection of advanced technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization, and executive-level client consulting. This is a senior individual contributor role with full ownership of the technical and visibility lifecycle: from log file analysis, Core Web Vitals remediation, and custom schema markup to engineering AEO frameworks for AI-driven search surfaces like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity, and delivering revenue-tied performance narratives directly to client VPs, Directors, and C-suite stakeholders. This is not a content-only or basic on-page role — it’s built for a practitioner who operates at the frontier of search and executes with minimal oversight.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Technical SEO Ownership: Conduct exhaustive technical SEO audits — managing crawl budgets, resolving complex indexation controls, mapping redirect architectures, and independently diagnosing and providing engineering-ready remediation paths for Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and site-speed issues in direct partnership with client development teams.
AEO Framework Architecture: Engineer advanced Answer Engine Optimization strategies to capture organic visibility on AI-driven search surfaces including Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging platforms — future-proofing clients’ search presence as the landscape evolves.

Content & Funnel Architecture: Construct keyword cluster networks (pillar-and-spoke) and execute competitive SERP mapping to capture high-intent B2B buyers across every stage of the sales funnel.
Executive Client Delivery: Lead high-stakes client kickoffs, strategy deep-dives, and monthly performance reviews with senior technology executives — translating complex technical data into clear, revenue-driving business narratives that strip the jargon for non-technical stakeholders.
Revenue Measurement: Build comprehensive measurement frameworks via GA4 and client CRMs to explicitly link organic visibility and keyword velocity to pipeline and revenue outcomes — keeping strategy anchored to the levers that move business, not vanity metrics.
Migration Strategy: Lead mitigation planning and oversight for large-scale, high-risk website migrations, ensuring clients maintain organic momentum throughout transitions.




What You Bring

Senior SEO Experience: 7+ years of proven SEO experience with verified depth in technical execution and multi-faceted search strategy — including extensive agency or consulting environment tenure managing 3+ concurrent client accounts.
B2B SaaS & Enterprise Track Record: A proven track record of moving the needle specifically for mid-market or enterprise B2B software and SaaS clients — not SMB or eCommerce-focused backgrounds.
Advanced Technical Depth: Deep expertise in crawl budget optimization, log file analysis, schema deployment, and managing complex JavaScript SEO and single-page application (SPA) rendering challenges — paired with expert-level mastery of Screaming Frog (including custom extraction and JS rendering), Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, and GA4.
AEO & AI Search Fluency: Native familiarity with or strong conceptual command of emerging AI search visibility platforms and Answer Engine Optimization frameworks across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar surfaces.
Executive Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills — able to write executive-quality audit roadmaps that make complex technical strategy accessible to VP, Director, and C-suite stakeholders without losing rigor.
Autonomy & Strategic Ownership: A senior practitioner mindset — able to build your own 90-day roadmaps, prioritize ruthlessly based on revenue impact, and execute with minimal oversight across multiple concurrent accounts.




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren’t just joining a company; you’re joining a movement to redefine how the world’s best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.

Job Title: Appointment Setter / Lead Generation Specialist




About the Company:

Our client is building a centralized revenue operations team to support lead generation across several affiliated businesses. They specialize in providing strategic growth and operational system solutions to companies experiencing growing pains.




Job Description:

Our client is seeking two dedicated individuals to join their revenue operations team. These roles will focus on outbound calling, personalized emails, and potentially LinkedIn outreach to qualified prospects on behalf of different businesses. The primary goal is to initiate credible business conversations, identify potential needs, qualify a basic fit, and schedule appointments for company leaders. This is not a sales closing role, but rather a crucial step in the sales pipeline.

The ideal candidates will be confident, articulate, curious, and capable of engaging in natural business conversations, moving beyond rigid scripts. A strong listener who can identify client needs and a proactive approach to accountability are highly valued.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Contact qualified prospects via phone calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn.

• Initiate credible business conversations.

• Identify potential client needs.

• Qualify a basic fit for the client's services.

• Schedule appointments for company leaders.

• Research companies and decision-makers.

• Maintain an accurate list of prospects, organized by campaign and client.

• Prepare prospect information for outreach.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Proven experience in outbound calling, specifically B2B appointment setting.

• Strong spoken English that is easy for business owners to understand.

• Ability to speak naturally and conversationally, rather than solely relying on scripts.

• Contact data verification skills.

• Proficiency with spreadsheets and CRM data management.

• Confident and articulate.

• Comfortable with rejection.

Software & Tools:

• CRM systems

Schedule:

Salary and Benefits:

• Hourly rate with potential for bonuses for successful sales.

About the job

About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

 

POSITION SUMMARY 

Own Workday integrations end-to-end, driving reliable data flow and scalable system design. Elevate architecture standards while bridging technical and business stakeholders. Enable high-quality user experiences through automated testing, reporting, and AI-driven insights. The Workday Integrations & Data Specialist is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining integrations between Workday and internal or third-party systems. This role ensures accurate, secure, and timely data flow across HR, payroll, finance, IT, and benefits platforms while supporting reporting, automation, AI-enabled insights, and scalable system design.

This role partners closely with HRIS, IT, Finance, Payroll, Core HCM architects, and external vendors to ensure Workday functions as a reliable system of record within a cohesive technology ecosystem. This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

Workday Integrations & Data Management

Design, build, test, and maintain Workday integrations using tools such as EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and APIs

Collaborate across HR, IT, Finance, and vendors to align solutions with business needs

Security & Compliance

Ensure integrations meet security, privacy, and compliance standards
Manage secure data transfers and authentication methods across systems

ADP / global payroll vendors

About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The Team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro team is responsible for everything to do with the trading backend services such as the matching engine, market data gateways, internal and external APIs, and various other trading services. The team is located globally and responsibilities are split into sub-teams, working with various tech stacks. Our teams code in Rust and work agile around the globe. Recently, the team played a critical role in scaling Kraken's trading infrastructure.

The Opportunity

As an SDET within Kraken Pro, you'll be embedded directly within engineering teams as a software engineer focused on quality.

You'll help build and maintain automated testing solutions, CI/CD tooling, and quality engineering workflows for complex backend systems and APIs. Working closely with product engineers, you'll contribute to ensuring the reliability, performance, and correctness of Kraken's trading platform.

Depending on the team or product area you join, you may work on matching engine services, market data infrastructure, external APIs, Futures and Derivatives systems, and other areas of the Pro trading stack.

title: Logistics Tracking Coordinator (Remote)
description:
About the job

Location: Remote — Latin America (open to candidates in Colombia, Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, and nearby countries)

Schedule: Full Time, aligned to U.S. Eastern business hours

Compensation: $7 to $10 per hour, based on experience and country




About ATC

ATC is a fast paced transportation and logistics company specializing in freight coordination, dispatch, and brokered transport. We are growing our air cargo business, moving imports, exports, and domestic and international airport shipments, and we are building a structured, high accountability operations team to keep every shipment on track.




Position Overview

The Logistics Tracking Coordinator owns the day to day follow up on our air cargo shipments. As we take on new airport customers, this role makes sure nothing slips through the cracks between our team, the local carriers, the airlines, and our customers. This is a remote, high volume, follow up heavy position built around consistent communication, careful record keeping, and reliability. You will report to the Operations and Billing team and work closely with our controller to take follow up work off their plate.




We keep our shipments centralized in our logistics platform, so you will have a clear view of what is moving and where follow up is needed. Training on our systems and processes is provided.




Key Responsibilities

Carrier & Airline Coordination

• Follow up with local carriers picking up and delivering air cargo to and from airlines at airports, both domestic and international.

• Confirm that carriers have received the paperwork we send and have everything they need to move each shipment.

• Coordinate pickup and delivery appointments and confirm dates with carriers and airlines.




Tracking & Documentation 

• Monitor active shipments in our logistics platform (TMS) and keep status updates accurate and current.

• Obtain proof of delivery (POD) documents and send them to customers promptly.

• Keep clear, accurate notes on every carrier and customer interaction so the whole team has full visibility at any time.

• Gathering final charges after completed deliveries




Customer Communication

• Provide timely status updates to customers on pickups, deliveries, and any exceptions.

• Send and manage a high volume of follow up emails with carriers, airlines, and customers throughout the day.

• Escalate delays or issues to the team with full context so they can be resolved quickly. 




Qualifications

• Fluent, professional English, written and spoken. You will be emailing carriers and customers constantly.

• Strong follow up discipline and a real sense of urgency. You chase items down until they are resolved and do not let them sit. 

• Highly organized and detail oriented, with disciplined note taking and record keeping.

• Reliable and responsible, with consistent availability during U.S. business hours.

• Comfortable managing a large volume of email and juggling several shipments at once.

• A quiet remote work setup with reliable internet and a computer.




Preferred but not required

• Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, air cargo, or a 3PL back office.

• Familiarity with a TMS or logistics dashboard. We provide training on our system, so this is a plus, not a must.
